metadata.title: Meta Stock Jumps After Unveiling New AI Coding Model

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Meta Platforms ( META ) gained about 3% Thursday after introducing Muse Spark 1.3, a new artificial intelligence model built around extended agentic tasks and software development, according to the company.
Meta said the model supports Muse Code, a coding agent designed to work through terminal and continuous integration environments. The tool can plan tasks, modify projects and execute commands while using approvals and an operating-system sandbox.
Muse Spark 1.3 also posted higher scores than Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 and OpenAI's GPT 5.6 Sol in several coding benchmarks, including DeepSWE v1.1 and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
However, the model did not lead across every test. Claude Opus 5 and GPT 5.6 Sol scored better in several agent-focused benchmarks. Meta's broader Muse lineup also includes models for image generation, voice transcription and other applications.
The release adds to Meta's AI push, though the competitive results suggest investors will be watching how quickly these models translate into products and revenue.
